searchText: Hey, we have started running all of our current 4844 fixtures from `execution-spec-tests`, within our `pyspec` simulator in hive (only for `go-ethereum` using the `mdehoog/eip-4844` branch). I was wondering if any other execution client teams have a 4844 branch they are open to sharing with us, so we can run these tests against them 🧪 ? Will post nethermind's one tomorrow Do somebody have the go-kzg repo? I found <@203220829473996800> one but says it is experimental <asn_d6> https://github.com/crate-crypto/go-kzg-4844 Oh thank you <asn_d6> np! Oh this is cool actually, we dont have to implement anything crypto wise Thanks 🙂 racytech (github username) has already upstreamed inclusion of go-kzg-4844 into erigon, though I would like to move the context initialization into erigon-lib since kzg functions are also needed in the external txpool service.
